now / block.timestamp used in Token for tax period normalisation and elapsed-time loops.

balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value, unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf[_to] += _value, unchecked addition.
balanceOf[msg.sender] += _value in mint, only a post-hoc overflow guard.

balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value in burn.
totalSupply -= _value in burn.
balanceOf[addresses[i]] -= amtOfTaxToPay inside the tax loop.
balanceOf[owner] += amtOfTaxToPay inside the tax loop.
Unbounded while loop over (now - lastHoldingTax) that can be forced to iterate many times by miners.

Owner-only termination of the sale, guarded by now and remaining token count.

Owner-only reconciliation reading ps and pts to adjust numberOfTokensLeft.

Caller of tokensale functions; receives tokens/refunds and passes owner checks.
now / block.timestamp used for sale phase selection and termination checks.
finalAddress.send(this.balance) forwards the whole balance to an external address.
finalAddress.send(amount) external ether transfer in withdraw.
msg.sender.send(weiLeftOver) refunds excess ether to an attacker-controlled address.
numberOfTokensLeft -= dif * 100 executed on every purchase without an underflow guard on the multiplied term.
numberOfTokensLeft -= tokensToGive during purchase.
numberOfTokensLeft -= dif * 100 / diff in updatePresaleNumbers, unchecked subtraction that can underflow.
withdrawLimit -= amount after the bound check.

edges.reason: msg.sender receives the entire initial supply in the constructor.
msg.sender is the debited account and controls tax and private-mode exemption branches.
msg.sender must equal owner for mint to execute.
msg.sender must equal owner for burn to execute.
msg.sender must equal owner to change txnTax.
msg.sender must equal owner to change holdingTax.
msg.sender must equal owner to change holdingTaxInterval.
msg.sender must equal owner and isPrivate must hold for addAddressManual.
msg.sender must equal owner and isPrivate must hold for removeAddressManual.
now is used in the constructor to normalise lastHoldingTax to Friday 21:00.
now - lastHoldingTax drives the number of tax periods charged.
getWeekday is called on the now-derived lastHoldingTax.
getHour is called on the now-derived lastHoldingTax.
getMinute is called on the now-derived lastHoldingTax.
getSecond is called on the now-derived lastHoldingTax.
owner is read for the txnTax exemption branch.
owner equality check gates changeTxnTax.
owner equality check gates mint.
owner equality check gates burn.
owner equality check gates changeHoldingTax.
owner equality check gates changeHoldingTaxInterval.
owner equality check gates addAddressManual.
owner equality check gates removeAddressManual.
txnTax is read to decide whether to pay the owner.
isPrivate is read to restrict transfers to known addresses.
addressExists[_to] is read for the private transfer check.
addAddress tests addressExists before inserting.
numberOfAddress is used as the insertion index.
numberOfAddress bounds the tax loop over the address book.
holdingTax is a factor of the tax amount computation.
holdingTaxInterval scales the elapsed period in the loop condition.
holdingTaxDecimals is used twice as a divisor, easily yielding zero tax.
lastHoldingTax is the baseline for the period computation.
holder balances are read, debited and the owner balance credited in the tax loop.
sender and recipient balances are read before the subtraction/addition.
totalSupply is incremented with _value in mint.
totalSupply is decremented with _value in burn.
owner.send(txnTax) is performed before the sender/recipient balances are updated.
The external send to owner can re-enter transfer before state changes complete.
transfer executes balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value.
transfer executes balanceOf[_to] += _value.
mint executes balanceOf[msg.sender] += _value.
mint executes totalSupply += _value.
burn executes balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value.
burn executes totalSupply -= _value.
chargeHoldingTax debits each non-owner balance.
chargeHoldingTax credits the owner balance.
The tax period loop is driven entirely by block.timestamp arithmetic.
transfer calls addAddress(_to) after updating balances.
addAddressManual delegates to addAddress.
removeAddressManual delegates to removeAddress.
The Token constructor calls addAddress(owner).
msg.sender becomes the tokensale owner at deployment.
msg.sender must equal owner to end the presale.
msg.sender must equal owner to withdraw.
msg.sender must equal owner to reconcile presale numbers.

buyer balance is credited with the computed token amount.

numberOfTokensLeft caps the purchase and is decremented.
pricePerToken converts msg.value into tokens.
ps.numberOfTokensLeft and ps.numberOfTokens are queried for reconciliation.
pts.numberOfTokensLeft and pts.numberOfTokens are queried for reconciliation.
The fallback reads live values from the presale contract on every purchase.
The fallback reads live values from the previous tokensale contract on every purchase.
tokensFromPresale cache is read and overwritten to compute the delta.
tokensFromPresale is updated on every purchase, making presale deltas attacker-influenceable.
